purpose: Provide an in-memory repository for Order entities used by service-layer operations, supporting save, retrieval, customer-scoped listing, and a mark-paid workflow that coordinates with the Order domain model.
role: repository module; in-memory data access adapter for the Order domain
components: Class OrderRepository: in-memory repository keyed by order_id; constructor initializes empty orders mapping; provides save(order), get(order_id), list_by_customer(customer_id), and mark_paid(order_id, payment_id) that retrieves, invokes Order.mark_paid, then persists via save
internal_structure: The module exports OrderRepository as its primary component. The repository maintains an internal mapping keyed by order_id initialized at construction. Operational methods manipulate this mapping. mark_paid orchestrates a small workflow: get the order, delegate to Order.mark_paid, then persist with save; internal edges show mark_paid calls get and save.
module_mechanism: Consumers (e.g., CLI demo builder and service layer) instantiate OrderRepository and invoke its public methods. The module depends on typing for annotations and on the Order model for domain behavior during mark_paid. It raises validation and lookup errors across the module boundary and provides an in-memory data source for higher-level services.
outputs: save mutates repository state; no return value
get returns Order for the given order_id
list_by_customer returns List[Order] filtered by customer_id
mark_paid returns the updated Order after persisting
side_effects: Mutates internal orders mapping on save and mark_paid
Overwrites existing entries on duplicate order_id in save
Persists domain changes during mark_paid by delegating to Order.mark_paid and re-saving
Raises exceptions on validation and lookup failures
errors: ValueError: order_id is required (save) when order.order_id is falsy
KeyError: order {order_id} not found (get) when the id is absent
AttributeError: Encountered an order without a customer_id attribute while filtering (list_by_customer)
AttributeError: The orders collection does not implement values() (list_by_customer)
<SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Order.mark_paid</SPL> raises an error while marking the order as paid (mark_paid)
<SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.repository.OrderRepository.get</SPL> raises an error while retrieving the order (mark_paid)
<SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.repository.OrderRepository.save</SPL> raises an error while saving the updated order (mark_paid)
AttributeError: Attempting to call mark_paid on a None order value (mark_paid)
Retrieved order is None, causing a failure on mark_paid invocation (mark_paid)
initialization_order: Instantiate OrderRepository before OrderService methods invoke repository operations (constructed via cli.build_demo_service)
summary: Provide an in-memory repository for Order entities used by service-layer operations, supporting save, retrieval, customer-scoped listing, and a mark-paid workflow that coordinates with the Order domain model.
